geography: Archer City, Mount Barry, Briar Creek, Rattlesnake Canyon and Craddock bonebed
Texas and New Mexico, United States
overview: Named Dimetrodon and cf. Dimetrodon teeth preserve variation in tooth edges and cusps, while a character-matrix study compares sphenacodontid relationships. Neither isolated teeth nor that tree identify a direct mammalian ancestor.

ecology.diet: Predatory feeding inferred from sphenacodontid tooth anatomy; individual prey is not preserved
ecology.habitat: Fully terrestrial apex-predator interpretation for the sampled sphenacodontids; habitat breadth is unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Not measured by the dental sample
ecology.bodySize: The profile does not infer a genus-wide mass or body-length range
ecology.guild: Terrestrial predator inference bounded to the source's sampled ecological interpretation

traits: MCZ 2779 snout with enlarged anterior maxillary tooth
MCZ 2028 and UMMP 9722 dentary teeth with lingual cusp variation
Carina and denticle character changes optimized in the sampled phylogeny
evidenceSummary: The study sample comes from Early Permian localities in Texas and New Mexico and spans 290.1–273 Ma. Predatory feeding and repeated dental-character change are interpretations of the sampled material, not a complete genus history or a record of specific prey.

title.en: Tooth edges and cusps vary across specimens
title.zh: 不同标本的齿缘与齿尖各有变化

text.en: The study discusses teeth and skull material from named Dimetrodon species and cf. Dimetrodon, including an enlarged front maxillary tooth and variation in lingual cusps. Carinae, the sharp edges of a tooth, and denticles, their small serrations, are compared in the character matrix. Tooth form supports a predatory interpretation, but no particular prey is preserved with these specimens.
text.zh: 研究讨论了具名 Dimetrodon 物种及 cf. Dimetrodon 的牙齿和头骨材料，其中包括增大的前部上颌牙及舌侧齿尖变化。矩阵比较了齿刃——牙齿的锐利边缘——和小锯齿。牙齿形态支持捕食性解释，但这些标本没有保存可识别的具体猎物。

title.en: A dental tree is not an ancestor sequence
title.zh: 牙齿性状树不是祖先序列

text.en: The sampled character matrix places included Dimetrodon species within Sphenacodontidae and records repeated changes in dental characters. A branching analysis tests relationships among included forms; it does not show that Dimetrodon gave rise directly to mammals. The 290.1–273 Ma span is the Early Permian sample window from Texas and New Mexico, not a complete global range for the genus.
text.zh: 所取样的性状矩阵把纳入的 Dimetrodon 物种置于楔齿龙科，并记录多次牙齿性状变化。分支分析检验的是纳入类群之间的关系，并未证明 Dimetrodon 直接演化成哺乳动物。290.1–273 Ma 是得克萨斯州与新墨西哥州早二叠世样本的时间窗口，不是该属完整的全球分布年代。

overviewZh: 列出的 Dimetrodon 和 cf. Dimetrodon 牙齿显示齿缘和齿尖存在差异；一项特征矩阵研究则比较了楔齿龙科的亲缘关系。孤立的牙齿和该系统树都无法确定谁是哺乳动物的直接祖先。
evidenceSummaryZh: 研究样本来自德克萨斯州和新墨西哥州的早二叠世产地，年代跨度为 290.1–273 Ma。捕食性摄食和牙齿特征的反复变化，是对这些样本的解释，并非该属的完整历史或特定猎物的记录。

commonNameZh: 达善沟基干兽孔类标本
overview: The early therapsid record here is a snout, not a complete skeleton. Holotype IVPP V15424 is a roughly 100 mm fragment from the Middle Permian Dashankou locality. A published analysis scored 71 anatomical characters and placed Raranimus dashankouensis near the base of Therapsida in that matrix. Its canine pattern and other cranial features help test that position, but the fossil is not a demonstrated ancestor and the formation has no reliable direct radiometric date in the cited account.
overviewZh: 这里的早期兽孔类记录是一段吻部，不是一具完整骨架。正模 IVPP V15424 是来自中二叠世大山口地点、约 100 毫米长的吻部残片。一项已发表分析编码 71 个解剖性状，并在该矩阵中将 Raranimus dashankouensis 放在兽孔类基部附近。犬齿组合和其他头部性状可用于检验这一位置，但化石不是已证实的祖先；所引研究还指出，大山口组缺少可靠的直接放射性定年。

ecology.diet: Carnivory is inferred from the snout’s cranial and dental morphology.
ecology.habitat: The Xidagou Formation provides a continental depositional context; the animal’s exact habitat is unresolved.
ecology.locomotion: The partial snout does not preserve evidence of locomotion.
ecology.bodySize: The only described holotype is an approximately 100 mm snout fragment; this is not a body-length estimate.
ecology.guild: The dentition has been interpreted as that of a small terrestrial predator; this remains an inference.
ecology.dietZh: 食肉性是根据吻部的头骨与牙齿形态推断的。
ecology.habitatZh: 西大沟组提供了大陆沉积环境背景；该动物的确切生境仍未确定。
ecology.locomotionZh: 部分吻部没有保存可用于判断运动方式的证据。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 唯一描述过的正模是一段约 100 毫米长的吻部碎片；这不是体长估计。
ecology.guildZh: 其齿列被解释为属于小型陆生捕食者；这仍是推断。

traits: Partial snout combining cranial and dental characters used in the diagnosis
The diagnosis discusses a double-canine condition
The matrix places Raranimus near the base of sampled Therapsida
evidenceSummary: The named holotype and 71-character matrix let researchers test early therapsid relationships, but the result depends on that partial skull and its scoring. The cited account reports no reliable direct radiometric date for the Dashankou Formation. Neither the matrix position nor the snout demonstrates ancestry.
evidenceSummaryZh: 具名正模和 71 性状矩阵为检验早期兽孔类亲缘关系提供了材料，但结果受这件不完整头骨及其编码方式限制。所引研究没有给大山口组提供可靠的直接放射性定年；矩阵位置和吻部残片都不证明祖先关系。

readerLimitations.en: The placement comes from a 71-character analysis of a partial snout; the cited account reports no reliable direct radiometric date for the Dashankou sequence. The matrix position and broad stage-based display do not demonstrate direct ancestry or a precise lineage duration.
readerLimitations.zh: 其位置来自对一段吻部残片编码的71项性状分析；所引记述没有给大山口层序提供可靠的直接放射性定年。矩阵中的位置和按阶估算的宽泛展示范围，都不能证明直系祖先关系或精确谱系延续时间。

traitsZh: 部分吻部材料结合了用于鉴定的颅骨和牙齿特征。
鉴别描述讨论了双犬齿状态。
在所取样的兽孔类中，矩阵分析将 Raranimus 置于接近基部的位置。

overview: CT data from the named jaws MCZ7/95A–B and MCZ10/G95 show the tooth-bearing dentary, a trough behind it and rows of teeth with wear surfaces. A character matrix placed sampled Late Triassic haramiyids outside crown Mammalia; that placement belongs to the cited analysis. Tooth shape and wear support plant processing and a backward jaw stroke, but these are interpretations, not direct records of diet or behaviour.
overviewZh: 具名颌骨 MCZ7/95A–B 和 MCZ10/G95 的 CT 数据显示了承齿的齿骨、其后的沟槽，以及带有磨耗面的多排牙齿。形态矩阵将所取样的晚三叠世哈拉米亚类动物置于哺乳动物冠群之外；这只是所引分析得到的位置。牙齿形态和磨耗支持植物加工及下颌向后移动的解释，但它们并未直接记录真实食物或行为。

ecology.diet: Complex teeth and wear facets support plant processing; actual diet is not observed.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from continental deposits of the Fleming Fjord Formation; the animal's living habitat is not established by the jaws.
ecology.locomotion: Movement is not preserved by the jaw material.
ecology.bodySize: Described as a small mammaliaform; the jaw sample does not establish whole-body mass.
ecology.guild: Plant processing is inferred from the teeth; an ecological role is not directly observed.
ecology.dietZh: 复杂牙齿和磨耗面支持其能够处理植物；实际食物并未被直接观察。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自 Fleming Fjord 组的陆相沉积；仅凭颌骨无法确定动物的生活生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 颌部材料没有保存移动信息。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 它被描述为一种小型哺乳形类；下颌样本不能确定全身质量。
ecology.guildZh: 根据牙齿推断其处理植物；其生态角色并未被直接观察。

traits: Jaw-joint condyle and a trough behind the dentary
Rows of complex teeth behind the front of the jaw
Backward jaw movement inferred from tooth-wear geometry
evidenceSummary: The named Greenland jaws support anatomical and tooth-wear observations, while placement outside crown Mammalia and plant processing are interpretations. The 205.7–201.4 Ma Rhaetian interval translates the formation context; it is not the full range of Haramiyida or an age for the mammal crown.
evidenceSummaryZh: 具名格陵兰颌骨支持解剖和牙齿磨耗观察；冠群之外的位置与植物加工都属于解释。205.7–201.4 Ma 的瑞替期区间是这些地层背景的换算，不代表哈拉米亚目的完整延限，也不是哺乳动物冠群的年代。
traitsZh: 颌关节髁突，以及齿骨后方的沟槽。
下颌前部之后排列着数列复杂牙齿。
根据齿面磨耗几何形态推断下颌可向后移动。

commonNameZh: 摩尔根兽类颅骨标本组
overview: The Lower Jurassic skull study compares Morganucodon watsoni from Wales with M. oehleri from China. In the described anatomy, contact between the squamosal and dentary bones coexists with a retained articular–quadrate jaw joint. This mosaic is not a linear sequence or evidence that one species directly gave rise to another.

ecology.diet: The skulls preserve distinct incisors, canines, premolars, and molars. That dental differentiation is anatomical evidence, but the study does not directly observe diet.
ecology.habitat: The described specimens come from Lower Jurassic deposits in Wales and China. These localities are representative material, not a complete geographic range or proof of a single life habitat.
ecology.locomotion: The skull comparison does not establish how Morganucodontans moved.
ecology.bodySize: The described M. watsoni skull is 26 mm long; the M. oehleri skull is slightly larger. These skull measurements do not establish body size across the order.
ecology.guild: Two skull samples do not support an order-wide ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 头骨保存了形态有别的门齿、犬齿、前臼齿和臼齿。这种牙齿分化是解剖证据，但研究没有直接观察食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 所描述的标本来自威尔士和中国的下侏罗统沉积层。这些地点仅代表已研究的材料，既不构成完整地理分布范围，也不能证明其只有一种生活环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 头骨比较不能确定 Morganucodontans 如何移动。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所描述的 M. watsoni 头骨长 26 mm；M. oehleri 的头骨略大。这些头骨测量值无法确定整个目级类群的体型。
ecology.guildZh: 两组头骨样本不足以支持为整个目指定生态功能类群。

traits: The described M. watsoni skull measures 26 mm; the M. oehleri skull is slightly larger.
The teeth are differentiated into incisors, canines, premolars, and molars.
The described jaw shows squamosal–dentary contact while retaining the articular–quadrate joint.
evidenceSummary: Kermack and colleagues document the two named Morganucodon skull samples and their anatomy. Luo and colleagues' character analysis samples Morganucodontans among mammaliaforms. These sources support bounded anatomical and taxonomic comparisons, not a complete order-wide distribution or direct-ancestor claim.
overviewZh: 一项下侏罗统头骨研究比较了来自威尔士的 Morganucodon watsoni 与来自中国的 M. oehleri。所述解剖中，鳞骨与齿骨接触，同时保留关节骨—方骨颌关节。这种镶嵌组合不是线性演化序列，也不表明一个物种直接演化成另一个物种。
evidenceSummaryZh: Kermack 等人记录了这两件具名 Morganucodon 头骨样本及其解剖；Luo 等人的性状分析则在哺乳形类中取样了摩根齿兽类。这些来源支持有界的解剖和分类比较，不支持目级完整分布或直接祖先关系。

scope.zh: Kermack 等（1981），第 1–158 页，尤其第 1–8 页：Morganucodon watsoni 与 M. oehleri 头骨样本、26 毫米头骨、颌关节及牙列。

title.en: A 26 mm skull with a jaw-joint mosaic
title.zh: 26 毫米头骨中的颌关节镶嵌

text.en: The Lower Jurassic skull study compares Morganucodon watsoni from Wales with M. oehleri from China. In the described anatomy, contact between the squamosal and dentary bones coexists with a retained articular–quadrate jaw joint. This mosaic is not a linear sequence or evidence that one species directly gave rise to another.
text.zh: 一项下侏罗统头骨研究比较了来自威尔士的 Morganucodon watsoni 与来自中国的 M. oehleri。所述解剖中，鳞骨与齿骨接触，同时保留关节骨—方骨颌关节。这种镶嵌组合不是线性演化序列，也不表明一个物种直接演化成另一个物种。

title.en: Two Morganucodon samples in a mammaliaform analysis
title.zh: 哺乳形类分析中的两组 Morganucodon 样本

text.en: Kermack and colleagues document the two named Morganucodon skull samples and their anatomy. Luo and colleagues' character analysis samples Morganucodontans among mammaliaforms. These sources support bounded anatomical and taxonomic comparisons, not a complete order-wide distribution or direct-ancestor claim.
text.zh: Kermack 等人记录了这两件具名 Morganucodon 头骨样本及其解剖；Luo 等人的性状分析则在哺乳形类中取样了摩根齿兽类。这些来源支持有界的解剖和分类比较，不支持目级完整分布或直接祖先关系。

traitsZh: 所描述的 M. watsoni 头骨长 26 毫米；M. oehleri 的头骨稍大。
牙齿分化为门齿、犬齿、前臼齿和臼齿。
所描述的下颌显示鳞骨与齿骨相接，同时保留关节骨—方骨关节。

overview: Near-complete holotype IVPP V16051 preserves a detached ectotympanic and malleus linked to the dentary by ossified Meckel’s cartilage, documenting one anatomical mosaic rather than a universal transition stage.

ecology.diet: Animal-feeding diet inferred from eutriconodont dentition
ecology.habitat: Jiufotang lacustrine depositional setting; exact life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial locomotion inferred; performance not measured
ecology.bodySize: Small-bodied mammal known from a near-complete skeleton
ecology.guild: Small terrestrial faunivore inferred from dentition

traits: Ossified Meckel’s cartilage linking ear and dentary
evidenceSummary: The holotype directly supports the anatomical observations, but the stabilizing function of the ossified cartilage and its evolutionary significance remain interpretations rather than observed performance or ancestry.

title.en: A middle ear still linked to the jaw
title.zh: 仍与下颌相连的中耳结构

text.en:
Near-complete holotype IVPP V16051 preserves a detached ectotympanic and malleus alongside ossified Meckel’s cartilage. The ectotympanic forms part of the middle ear, the malleus is one of its small sound-transmitting bones, and Meckel’s cartilage runs along the lower jaw in mammals. Their arrangement makes the specimen unusually informative about how the mammalian ear and jaw were related.

The preserved cartilage supports a transitional anatomical interpretation: ear elements had become distinct, yet a connection to the dentary remained. That combination is a character state in one fossil, not a direct observation of soft-tissue motion or proof that Liaoconodon was the ancestor of later mammals.
text.zh:
近完整正模 IVPP V16051 保存了分离的鼓骨和锤骨，也保存了骨化的麦氏软骨。鼓骨是中耳的一部分，锤骨是传递声音的小骨之一；哺乳动物的麦氏软骨沿下颌延伸。这些结构的组合使该标本能为中耳与下颌之间的关系提供罕见信息。

保存下来的软骨支持一种过渡性解剖解释：耳部骨骼已分化出来，但仍与齿骨相连。这是单件化石中的性状组合，并非对软组织运动的直接观察，也不能证明 Liaoconodon 是后期哺乳动物的直系祖先。
